Modifies your focus list. When you have users on your focus list, the characters you can visually see in the chatroom are filtered to only those on your focus list. When your focus list is enabled, you will see the FocusEnabledWarningIcon icon on all characters. To go back to viewing all characters, use /focus clear or the button in the menu bar.

• If you normally would not be able to see a character on your focus list (e.g. sensory deprivation), they still will not be visible to you.
  • Neither chat messages nor map rooms are affected by the focus list.
  • If a player on your focus list leaves the room, they are removed from the list.
